def solve(case):
    payload = case.get("payload", case)
    
    nodes_list = payload["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(payload["required_symbols"])
    
    # Validate required fields
    for node in nodes_list:
        for field in ["id", "parent", "symbol", "depth", "removable", "utility"]:
            if field not in node:
                raise ValueError(f"Node missing required field: {field}")
    
    # Build data structures
    nodes = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes_list}
    
    # Validate tree structure
    root_nodes = [n for n in nodes_list if n["parent"] is None]
    if len(root_nodes) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Tree must have exactly one root node")
    
    # Build children map
    children = {nid: [] for nid in nodes}
    for n in nodes_list:
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            if n["parent"] not in nodes:
                raise ValueError(f"Parent {n['parent']} not found for node {n['id']}")
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    # Track retained nodes
    retained = set(nodes.keys())
    
    # Build candidate list: removable nodes, sorted by depth desc, then id asc
    candidates = [n for n in nodes_list if n["removable"]]
    # Sort: primary = depth descending, secondary = id ascending (lexicographic)
    candidates.sort(key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    removal_order = []
    
    for node in candidates:
        nid = node["id"]
        
        if nid not in retained:
            continue  # already removed
        
        # Check if node has retained children
        has_retained_children = any(c in retained for c in children[nid])
        if has_retained_children:
            continue
        
        # Tentatively remove: check if all required symbols remain
        symbols_after = {nodes[r]["symbol"] for r in retained if r != nid}
        
        if required_symbols.issubset(symbols_after):
            retained.remove(nid)
            removal_order.append(nid)
    
    return {
        "retained_ids": sorted(retained),
        "removal_order": removal_order
    }
```

def solve(case):
    # Support both wrapped (case_id+payload) and bare payload
    if "payload" in case:
        payload = case["payload"]
    else:
        payload = case
    
    nodes_list = payload.get("nodes")
    required_symbols_list = payload.get("required_symbols")
    
    if nodes_list is None:
        raise ValueError("Missing 'nodes' field")
    if required_symbols_list is None:
        raise ValueError("Missing 'required_symbols' field")
    
    required_symbols = set(required_symbols_list)
    
    # Validate each node
    for node in nodes_list:
        for field in ["id", "parent", "symbol", "depth", "removable", "utility"]:
            if field not in node:
                raise ValueError(f"Node missing required field '{field}': {node}")
    
    # Build node lookup
    node_ids = [n["id"] for n in nodes_list]
    if len(node_ids) != len(set(node_ids)):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate node IDs")
    nodes = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes_list}
    
    # Validate root
    root_nodes = [n for n in nodes_list if n["parent"] is None]
    if len(root_nodes) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected exactly one root, found {len(root_nodes)}")
    
    # Build children map and validate parents
    children = {nid: [] for nid in nodes}
    for n in nodes_list:
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            if n["parent"] not in nodes:
                raise ValueError(f"Node '{n['id']}' references unknown parent '{n['parent']}'")
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    # Validate required symbols are present in the tree
    all_symbols = {n["symbol"] for n in nodes_list}
    missing = required_symbols - all_symbols
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Required symbols not present in tree: {missing}")
    
    # Track retained nodes
    retained = set(nodes.keys())
    
    # Build candidate list: removable nodes sorted by depth desc, then id asc (lexicographic)
    candidates = sorted(
        [n for n in nodes_list if n["removable"]],
        key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"])
    )
    
    removal_order = []
    
    for node in candidates:
        nid = node["id"]
        
        if nid not in retained:
            continue  # already removed
        
        # Skip if node has retained children
        if any(c in retained for c in children[nid]):
            continue
        
        # Tentatively remove: check required symbols still covered
        symbols_after = {nodes[r]["symbol"] for r in retained if r != nid}
        if required_symbols.issubset(symbols_after):
            retained.discard(nid)
            removal_order.append(nid)
    
    return {
        "retained_ids": sorted(retained),
        "removal_order": removal_order
    }
```
